oh-story-dsh 是基于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）构建的社区插件，将 Oh Story 的小说方法库与 Drama Skills 的短剧生产流程带入 DSH。DSH 管理 Agent、会话、模型、权限和 Chat；插件提供创作 Skills、专业 Roles、项目协议与三栏工作台。
本项目与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属、合作或背书关系；DeepSeek Harness 名称与品牌素材归其权利人所有。
覆盖长篇、短篇、选题、扫榜、拆文、导入、审稿、去 AI 味与封面流程。13 个 Oh Story Skills 与 7 个专业 Roles 按固定上游版本随插件交付。
内置 Drama Skills 0.6.0 的 creator-first 工作流。每集按请求维护最多五份可读 Markdown：剧本.md、视觉设定.md、分镜.md、图片提示词.md、视频提示词.md；不预建空文档，也不倒补用户未点名的阶段。审查与生产交付继续使用 DSH 原生工具、权限和确认界面。
Drama Skills 0.6.0 是破坏性升级：v0.5 结构化项目应继续锁定 v0.5 并只读保留；迁移时新建项目根，逐集人工确认当前工作所需文档，不要在同一目录混用旧 JSON/JSONL 与新文档。
- 原生三栏布局：项目文件树、编辑器与官方 Chat 同屏，Trajectory、工具执行、Todo、审批和 Composer 保持 DSH 原生交互。
- 实时文件跟随：Agent 调用官方文件工具时，目标文件自动定位，编辑器同步呈现生成中的内容。
- Chat 文件导航：点击官方 Chat 中的作品文件名，文件树会定位并在编辑器打开对应文件。
- 创作文档预览：Markdown 支持标题、表格、任务列表、引用和代码块；JSONL 以带行号、类型和状态的结构化记录呈现。
- 安全编辑：支持源码编辑与快捷保存；人工未保存内容不会被并发 Agent 修改覆盖。
- 稳定长对话：消息区独立滚动，官方 Composer 固定在 Chat 栏底部。
需要 Node.js 24+。
1.

items.title: Nexus: Depth-Adaptive KV-Cache Splicing and Retrieval-Decoupled Tool Routing for Agentic LLMs on Unified Memory
items.one_liner: Highly relevant for developers building high-performance LLM agents with large toolsets on unified memory hardware.
items.summary: Nexus is a framework designed to reduce the time-to-first-token (TTFT) for agentic LLMs using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) by decoupling tool routing from schema prefill costs. It uses an INT8 semantic lookaside buffer for tool selection and generates arguments over compressed signatures rather than full spliced KV caches. While KV cache splicing is used, it is limited by RoPE phase drift, which Nexus manages with a depth-adaptive suffix redecode. The system achieves significant TTFT speedups and context savings while maintaining output fidelity.
items.bottom_line: Decoupling tool routing from full schema prefill allows agents to scale to hundreds of tools without the quadratic latency penalty of traditional context loading.

claims.text: Nexus decouples tool routing from schema-prefill costs using a semantic lookaside buffer.
claims.support_span: Nexus's primary lever is to decouple routing from the schema-prefill cost: an INT8 semantic lookaside buffer (SLB) with a calibrated cross-encoder margin gate selects tools by retrieval

claims.text: It achieves a 1.1-1.7x TTFT speedup at moderate context depths.

items.title: Representation Affects Retrieval: A Case Study of Skill Discovery and Routing in a Multimodal Agent Harness
items.one_liner: Practical insight for prompt engineering and tool-calling architecture in agentic systems.
items.summary: This case study of the Tinycloud multimodal agent harness explores how the representation of skills in system prompts affects an LLM's ability to select the correct tool. The research found that providing full instructions (inlined-body) for all skills ensures correct selection but can lead to lexical competition where similar names cause misrouting. Conversely, omitting skill details leads to discovery failures and slower execution. The study concludes that in-prompt exposure is not monotonically helpful and requires careful management of lexical signals.
items.bottom_line: More information in an agent's prompt does not always improve performance; lexical collisions between tool descriptions can actively cause the model to misroute tasks.

claims.text:
市面上绝大多数所谓的「AI 深度调研」，本质是 Wide Research：并行搜一堆来源，按主题分好类，给你一份工整的 checklist。看起来很全，事实也没错，但没用——它只有目录，没有判断。
这个 skill 把 Agent 掰到另一条路上：Deep Research。精读一手源，把它们之间的矛盾挑出来，最后落到一个业内人真的会跟你争论的判断上。
Wide Research 是 LLM 的出厂设置，产出的是「正确的废话」。这个 skill 就是一套护栏，把它从默认模式里拽出来。
一套四阶段工作流，以及比工作流更重要的东西：不让 Agent 跳过 Phase 0 的纪律。
Phase 0　元思考 — 绝不外包
一次搜索都还没发起，先拷问问题本身：为什么问这个？隐藏假设是什么？有没有一个「显而易见但其实不对」的标准答案，而这篇报告的全部价值就是说清它为什么不对？然后写下「好答案」该长什么样：核心论点摆到一屋子业内人面前得能吵起来，而不是集体点头。
Phase 1　一手源精读
找到那 3 到 5 篇真正的原始文献（财报、创始人自己写的博文、电话会议逐字稿、论文原文），完整读完。二手总结每转一手，洞见就蒸发一层。
Phase 2　对比与反例
选 2 到 3 个案例做深度对比，专门去挖失败案例和批评声音。收敛本身是发现，分歧背后的原因是更大的发现。
Phase 3　交叉验证
多源印证的可信，单源的标注存疑，互相矛盾的——这才是最有意思的地方，去分析这个矛盾意味着什么。
Phase 4　把论证写出来
段落优先于表格，每一章只推进一个论点，诚实标注不知道的部分。最后一道自检：如果核心结论放到业内不会引发任何争论，重写。
这个文件最值钱的部分是「翻车目录」：把 Agent 最容易走的捷径一条条写下来，每条都配一个检测信号，让你（或 Agent）当场判断是不是正在犯。
1 · 跳过 Phase 0 直接搜 没有假设引导，subagent 返回的是信息碎片，不是论证素材。
检测信号：subagent 的 prompt 里没有「假设」或「待验证的论点」。
2 · 拿 subagent 的返回结构当报告骨架 你会得到一个伪装成分析的主题目录。
检测信号：章节标题拿去当搜索关键词刚好合适（「定价对比」「适合谁」）——那是文件柜，不是论证。
3 · 用表格和 bullet 替代思考 一个洞见如果能塞进表格，它大概率不是洞见。
检测信号：删掉所有表格和 bullet 后，剩下的段落撑不起一篇文章。
4 · 结论太安全 「A 适合新手，B 适合老手」这种话不用调研就能说。
检测信号：核心结论发到专业群里，没人会出来反驳或讨论。
5 · 把「全面」当「深度」 10 个维度各 3 句，输给 3 个维度各 3 段。
检测信号：报告过万字，但核心论点三句话就能说完。
6 · 子 agent 递归 fan-out 一次真实事故就是这条规则的由来：主 agent 派 3 个 → 变 13 个 → 变 50+ → 最终 149 个 agent，一笔意外的 API 账单。
检测信号：你在给子 agent 的 prompt 里写了「你可以用 Agent 工具进一步搜索」。停，马上要炸。

items.title: Beyond End-to-End Success: Diagnosing Failures in Long-Horizon Security LLM Agents
items.one_liner: Security researchers should note that LLM agent failures often stem from upstream state discovery issues rather than the security task itself.
items.summary: A new diagnostic methodology for long-horizon security LLM agents reveals that task failures often occur during state discovery rather than the exercise of security capabilities. By instrumenting tasks with checkpoints, researchers found that many Gemini 2.5 Flash failures happened before the model even observed the state it needed to reuse. Interestingly, protocol-disambiguation guidance that improved Gemini 2.5 Flash performance actually had the opposite effect on Gemini 3.7 Flash. This suggests that failure modes shift between model generations, requiring granular diagnosis rather than just aggregate success metrics.
items.bottom_line: Guidance that improves state observation in one model generation can degrade performance in the next, highlighting the instability of prompt-based fixes for security agents.

items.title: Structured but Fragile: On the Limits of LLMs in Cybersecurity Decision-Making
items.one_liner: LLMs can mimic structured cybersecurity decision-making when given explicit attack graphs, but their reasoning is highly fragile and easily skewed by framing.
items.summary: Researchers investigate whether large language models can perform structured security reasoning when selecting defenses over attack graphs spanning ransomware, cloud abuse, Kubernetes, and ICS/OT intrusions, comparing their strategies against a game-theoretic optimization baseline. While LLMs produce coherent strategies close to the optimum when explicit attack-graph structures are provided, their capabilities are extremely fragile. LLM behavior is highly sensitive to prompt framing, graph complexity, and small wording changes, and relabeling a poor strategy as optimal dramatically improves its LLM evaluation score. Furthermore, LLM-generated solvers for the optimization problem scale poorly compared to purpose-built solvers. These findings indicate that LLMs only approximate structured cybersecurity reasoning under strict representations rather than applying it robustly.
key_facts: Scenarios tested: ransomware, supply-chain compromise, cloud abuse, Kubernetes attacks, POS malware, and ICS/OT intrusion
items.bottom_line: Large language models do not apply robust structured reasoning in cybersecurity decision-making, exhibiting extreme sensitivity to framing and graph complexity.

claims.text: When explicit attack-graph structure is provided, they often produce coherent strategies close to the optimization baseline.
claims.support_span: When explicit attack-graph structure is provided, they often produce coherent strategies close to the optimization baseline.

claims.text: LLM behaviour is increasingly fragile with graph complexity and is highly sensitive to framing.

items.title: Evaluating Skills, Not Just Agents: Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills
items.one_liner: ACES evaluates enterprise AI agent skills through live execution trials, revealing that static code scans miss crucial runtime workflow gains.
items.summary: Enterprise agent programs are transitioning to production, requiring evidence-based reviews of reusable skills and tool packages rather than static structural scans. Researchers present ACES (Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills), a repository-native framework that runs paired live trials with and without target skills, normalizes trajectories into the Agent Trajectory Interchange Format (ATIF), and reports Skill Lift across runtime metrics. Evaluating 145 real enterprise skills, static scans and LLM judges measure complementary facets with a Spearman correlation of only 0.14. Across 947 scored paired cases from 58 production skills, mean composite Skill Lift is 0.2134, with composite lift being positive in 72.8% of cases, surfacing operational improvements that document scans miss.
key_facts: Skills evaluated: 145 real skills from enterprise repositories
Scored paired cases: 947 cases across 58 production skills
items.bottom_line: Repository-native agentic continuous evaluation (ACES) measures true operational skill lift via live trials, addressing the limitations of static security and structure scans.

items.title: ARQ: Agentic CodeQL Query Refinement for C/C++ Vulnerability Detection
items.one_liner: arXiv paper introduces ARQ, an agentic framework that uses program synthesis and LLMs to automatically refine CodeQL queries for C/C++ vulnerability detection.
items.summary: An arXiv paper presents ARQ, an agentic framework that automatically refines C/C++ CodeQL static analysis queries using execution-grounded evidence from synthesized programs. By identifying execution disagreements where a synthesized program is genuinely vulnerable or safe but the query verdict disagrees, ARQ runs an LLM-based refinement loop to fix false positives and false negatives without requiring labeled datasets or vulnerability templates. Tested across commercial LLMs on Juliet and FormAI datasets, ARQ-refined queries increased true positive detection by up to 119.8% while maintaining at least 98.0% precision. The framework successfully resolved long-standing GitHub issues in the official CodeQL repository and discovered new bugs in libpng and zlib.
items.bottom_line: ARQ uses execution-grounded evidence from synthesized programs to automatically refine static analysis queries, dramatically increasing true positive rates while maintaining high precision.

claims.text: We present ARQ, an agentic framework that automatically refines C/C++ CodeQL queries using execution-grounded evidence from synthesized programs.
